# Charles Jiang, MD, MPH

> Changchuan (Charles) Jiang is a genitourinary medical oncologist and health services researcher at UT Southwestern Medical Center (Harold C. Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center) and Parkland Health in Dallas, Texas. Assistant Professor of Internal Medicine (Hematology/Oncology) and in the Peter O'Donnell Jr. School of Public Health.

## Focus areas
- Clinical trial access and equity: leads UT Southwestern's prostate cancer clinical trial access program across a county safety-net hospital (Parkland Health) and community sites, supported by the American Cancer Society (IMPACT Special Initiative Award, PI). Director, GU Clinical Trial Optimization, Parkland Cancer Center. Conquer Cancer Foundation/ASCO Career Development Award on physician-level factors in trial enrollment. Robert A. Winn Excellence in Clinical Trials CDA.
- Supportive care and health access: Co-Chair (2025–), Health Access and Disparities Committee, Multinational Association of Supportive Care in Cancer (MASCC); committee member since 2023. Research on transportation barriers, financial hardship, palliative care value, and supportive-care drug access.
- Insurance design and cancer care delivery: zero-premium Medicare Advantage plans, plan benefit design, prior authorization, oncologist networks, Part D formulary access, Medicaid expansion.
- AI in the oncology workflow: PI of an NCCN/Pfizer quality improvement award embedding reflex biomarker testing and a molecular-actionability dashboard in the EHR at a safety-net cancer program; member of the UTSW Simmons Cancer Center AI Steering Committee; LLM-generated plain-language trial summaries; scholarship on value alignment and licensure of clinical AI.

## Work under review or under way
- Variation in clinical trial enrollment among physicians and practices in community oncology (Flatiron Health, 205,743 patients, 1,664 physicians, 107 practices; 20% of physicians account for 80% of enrollments) — under review.
- Racial and ethnic disparities in trial enrollment across community practices — under review.
- Scoping review of large language model applications across the oncology clinical trial lifecycle — under review.
- Commentaries on value alignment in clinical AI and on licensing autonomous clinical AI — under review.
- ACS IMPACT prostate cancer trial access program (Parkland Health + UTSW regional sites), NCCN biomarker test-to-treatment initiative, COM-B physician interviews, discrete choice experiments on patient preferences — ongoing.

## Advisory areas
1. Trial feasibility and patient access (clinical development teams, CROs, trial networks): protocol feasibility, enrollment barrier assessment, referral and screening workflows, community and safety-net site activation.
2. Evidence, access, and payer strategy (medical affairs, RWE, HEOR, market access): research concept review, observational design with Flatiron Health, ConcertAI, SEER-Medicare, Epic Cosmos; Medicare Advantage and Part D benefit design, utilization management, drug pricing and shortages, financial toxicity.
3. Clinical workflow, AI, and supportive care (oncology technology, clinical AI, care delivery teams): use-case review, workflow assessment, pilot evaluation frameworks, patient-facing communication design.
Also: research collaborations, grand rounds, CME, and speaking. Engagements are independent of institutional roles and subject to institutional disclosure requirements.
